newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending last week's surge.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending last week's surge.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend last week's 8.4-percent surge, signalled by Friday's strong buying after price-fixing.

Some analysts said a correction was possible this week after the bourse's 31-percent gain since mid-December, though others noted that the market had recently proved strong enough to extend gains despite such expectations.

Analysts said NFI units and Optimus should extend Friday's surges, the former buoyed by a buy recommendation from SBC Warburg and the latter by the news it received orders to convert into shares 159 convertible bonds.
Optimus expects the move to boost January profit by 1.3 million zlotys. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
